name: Evo3
html:
Living With

Bio Ego Algo

Nature's Bio

where every output is an input, has evolved its self-healing "we" system over billions of years, driven by cause/effect, DNA/ripples.

Existential Threat: EXTREME CLIMATES

Sapiens' Ego

creates "me" stories, where inputs stimulate memories and generate selfserving outputs, driven by emotions – from suffering to elation, fear to love.

Existential Threat: BIO/NUCLEAR WAR

A.I.'s Algo

self-iterates, self-directs, and then can hack us emotionally at hyper-rhythmic, unnatural, inhuman "go" speeds in ever-expanding time/space dimensions.

Existential Threat: OUR ENSLAVEMENT

SANE LIVING acknowledges the existential threats and brings awareness to our insane ways and addictions that have brought us to this precipice. Behaving as both individuals and communities, we must become fully responsible and take immediate action to cultivate sane, practical alternatives.

Reconnecting to nature can be our grounding touchstone to bring BIO, EGO, and ALGO into a healthier balance, flow, and prosocial point of view.

This is the most hopeful path forward for humanity, replacing our existential threats with existential treats – healthy minds, bodies, communities, and natural environments – aligned with the power of regeneration and the humility of self-healing.

name: Inspiration
html:
Points of View

Inspiration

Great ideas from reliable sources — thought leaders and innovators from around the world.

Yuval Noah Harari

Israeli historian and author of Sapiens, Homo Deus, and 21 Lessons for the 21st Century. Harari writes about the "cognitive revolution" and examines free will, consciousness, intelligence, and happiness. He has said, "Homo sapiens as we know them will disappear in a century or so."

Favorite Videos →

David Attenborough

Celebrated English broadcaster and natural historian whose career spans seven decades. His iconic series — Life on Earth, The Blue Planet, Planet Earth — have defined wildlife filmmaking and inspired generations to engage with environmental issues.

Favorite Video →

Sam Harris

American author, philosopher, and neuroscientist. Host of the Making Sense podcast and creator of the Waking Up meditation app. His work spans rationality, ethics, free will, neuroscience, meditation, and artificial intelligence.

Favorite Video →

Elon Musk

Business magnate, engineer, and founder of SpaceX, Tesla, The Boring Company, and Neuralink. Co-founder of OpenAI. His work spans electric vehicles, space exploration, brain-computer interfaces, and sustainable energy.

Favorite Videos →

Ocean Alive

A World Ocean's Day PSA from Sea Shepherd Conservation Society. Created by Carson Strassman, a 14-year-old student at Millikan Middle School, this film won the Sea Shepherd student short film contest for World Oceans Day.

Favorite Video →

Zach Bush MD

Physician specializing in internal medicine, endocrinology, and hospice care. Internationally recognized educator on the microbiome as it relates to health, offering profound insights into human health and longevity.

Favorite Videos →

TED Talks

TED is a nonprofit devoted to spreading ideas, usually in the form of short, powerful talks (18 minutes or less). Covering everything from science to business to global issues in more than 100 languages.

Favorite Videos →

name: Sculpture
html:
The EVO 3 Sculpture

Standing over 8 feet tall on East Matilija Street in Ojai, California, the EVO3 Sculpture offers viewers the story of humanity — from its biological root through its egocentric development to its algorithmically-defined future — in the form of a giant metallic question mark with a drum integrated into its base.

Created by Sane Living founder Aubrey Balkind and built by artist Ray Cerino, the EVO 3 sculpture was welcomed by the Ojai City Council in 2018.

The Film

Read more about the philosophy that inspired EVO3.
